status: prospective source-specific nonvertical preflight frozen before numeric height-above-msl is parsed

source.vertical_semantics: source-native GPS height above mean sea level

outcome_blind_rows.height_operation: presence/nonblank only; never numeric parse before receipt
source_quality_filters: if visible is present and interpretable, exclude explicit false rows
if algorithm-marked-outlier is present and interpretable, exclude explicit true rows

session.rule: within individual, sort retained events by timestamp and split whenever consecutive gap >4 hours
session.rationale: identical to the already-frozen raw Movebank candidate screen; no new session rule is introduced

projection.rule: derive UTM zone from median retained longitude/latitude before numeric vertical opening

horizontal_individuality.role: prospective nonvertical axis metric opened before vertical magnitude
horizontal_individuality.cell_universe: all frozen 5-km cells in >=50-event repeat-individual session universe
horizontal_individuality.self_profile: equal-weight other eligible sessions of same individual, Jeffreys-smoothed over frozen cell universe
horizontal_individuality.other_profile: pool sessions within each other individual, smooth over same cell universe, then equal-weight other individuals
horizontal_individuality.target_score: mean target-event log P_self(cell) - log P_other(cell)
horizontal_individuality.aggregation: equal target session within individual, then equal individual
horizontal_individuality.null: whole-session identity permutation preserving exact session-count multiset per identity

vertical_structural_gate.target_common_support: target event's 5-km cell must occur in at least one other eligible session of same individual and at least one eligible session of another individual
vertical_structural_gate.estimator_evaluable_individual: at least one target session with >=50 common-support events
freeze_before_vertical: repeat-eligible IDs and all eligible sessions
exact vertically evaluable target sessions and support counts

future_vertical_primary.session_centering: subtract full frozen session median height-above-msl
future_vertical_primary.self_profile: equal-weight other frozen eligible sessions of same individual
future_vertical_primary.other_profile: pool sessions within each other individual then equal-weight other individuals
future_vertical_primary.common_cell_weighting: identical self-derived common-cell weights for self and other vertical profiles
future_vertical_primary.target_score: mean supported target-event log P_self(centered z)-log P_other(centered z)
future_vertical_primary.aggregation: equal target session within individual then equal individual
future_vertical_primary.null: whole-session identity permutation over frozen training universe; replay full profile/support pipeline

claim_boundary: Header PASS and structural PASS are distinct.
Horizontal identity is reported regardless of later vertical result.
If structural gate fails, height magnitude remains unopened and the source is a structural STOP.
If structural gate passes, the exact receipt must be committed before numeric height is opened.
No grid, session threshold, target-support threshold, individual exclusion or alternate vertical endpoint may change after output.
